df = pd.read_csv('inventory.csv')
print('Resource kinds and counts:')
print(df['resource_kind'].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())
lbs = df[df['resource_kind'].eq('load_balancer')].copy()
print('\nAll load balancers:')
print(lbs[['resource_id', 'requests_14d']].to_string(index=False))
zero = lbs[lbs['requests_14d'].eq(0)]
print('\nZero-request load balancers:', len(zero))
print(json.dumps({'resource_ids': zero['resource_id'].tolist()}, indent=2))
print('\nRows with zero in any utilization metric:')
print(df[df[['avg_cpu_pct_14d','max_network_mb_14d','requests_14d']].eq(0).any(axis=1)][['resource_id','resource_kind','avg_cpu_pct_14d','max_network_mb_14d','requests_14d']].to_string(index=False))
